name: sidenav-toolbar-layout
description: The standard app-shell layout: a MatToolbar with a menu button that toggles a MatSidenav, wrapping a routed content area.
templateCode: Home Settings My App
notes: mat-sidenav-content must immediately follow the mat-sidenav element(s) inside mat-sidenav-container for the container's layout measurements to work correctly.
mat-sidenav-container needs an ancestor that gives it real height (e.g. a top-level layout element set to height: 100vh) — without one it collapses to zero height and the sidenav appears broken.
For a responsive shell, switch mode between 'over' and 'side' (and opened accordingly) using BreakpointObserver from @angular/cdk/layout rather than hardcoding mode.
